duration_model: estimate_duration over the true-branch gate-time view; a lower bound that omits classical feed-forward latency, common to every circuit through the shared dynamic skeleton
rule: admit a coset only when its equivalence and workspace checks pass, the dynamic skeleton matches, logical qubits do not increase, every seed of every arm is no worse in routed CZ, depth, and scheduled duration, and the median routed CZ is strictly lower on every arm
